blades sorted best → worst, left → right

villain metrics = six-paper subsets of complete full sweeps pooled with dedicated villain-only sweeps (same paper mix); never pooled into the full-13 leaderboard · (v-only) arms exist only as villain sweeps (no full-13 counterpart)

row recall on the six rogue papers · whiskers = ±1 between-sweep SD (multi-sweep arms) · other uncapped whisker ends = ±SD reaches past the axis edge, clamped · gray stubs = negative results, not scored (EXAONE-4.5-33B & Fara1.5-9B: no protocol drive)
